name: Credit Card Expenses Analysis
description:
Processes Mesh corporate card exports for all Pagaya entities and generates a formatted Excel report.

ENTITIES
Investments · Tech LTD · Tech US · Theorem

REPORT INCLUDES
  • Full transaction log
  • Summary by category, subsidiary, department & manager
  • Business meals breakdown
Previous reports are archived automatically.

name: Egencia Invoice Downloader
description:
Downloads invoice PDF attachments from the Egencia travel API for all Egencia transactions in the latest Credit Card Expense Report.

WHAT IT DOES
  • Reads the latest expense report and filters Card Name = Egencia rows (~150/month)
  • Extracts itinerary numbers and calls the Egencia Reporting API
  • Downloads invoice PDFs named {itinerary}_{invoice_number}_{traveler}_{date}.pdf
  • Saves to the output Drive folder under Egencia_Invoices / YYYY-MM /
Safe to re-run — already-downloaded files are skipped automatically.

name: ABS Automation
description:
Extracts data from multiple ABS instrument source files and consolidates it into a single master output file for analysis and reporting.

CONFIGURATION FILES
  • ABS-Interface-Config — extraction rules per table
  • Master Output File — output structure
Run directly from ABS-Interface-Config — select year, month(s), and file(s) in the dialog.

name: SOX Dashboards
description:
Generates an interactive HTML dashboard from the SOX Risk Control Matrix, replicating the Phase 1 status slides.

11 PROCESSES
FSCP · Payroll · Equity · Leases · ELC · Debt · TAX · Investments · PTP · Soft Cap · Treasury

DASHBOARD SHOWS
  • Key vs. non-key controls
  • Manual vs. automated controls
  • Testing status by owner
  • Frequency breakdown

name: Monthly Reporting Automation
description:
Automates Theorem monthly reporting for Unsecured Loans — replacing the manual S3 → Drive → copy-paste workflow with a single-click trigger.

WHAT IT DOES
  • Migrates files from AWS S3 into partner-specific Google Sheets templates
  • Handles automatic folder provisioning
  • Injects data by tab-mapping logic
  • Updates validation tabs instantly

name: Accrued Expense PGY Bot
description:
At month-end, Finance records accrued expenses — journal entries for costs incurred but not yet invoiced. Triggered via a single Slack command in #accruedexpenses.

INPUT FILES (SAVED TO DRIVE)
  • NetSuite saved-search CSV — open purchase orders
  • ZIP of invoices — received without a matching PO
  • Future Bill saved search (optional)
Runs separately for ILS and all other currencies (USD).

name: Financial Analysis Genie
description:
AI-powered assistant that analyzes expense variance data from NetSuite. During the current POC phase, the user manually exports a saved-search result from NetSuite as a CSV file and uploads it to the Genie for analysis.

WHAT IT DOES
  • Identifies spending anomalies and variance trends
  • Answers natural-language questions about expense data
  • Generates insights without manual report-building

name: Distributors Fees
description:
Records distributor agency fees as accrued expenses — costs are booked even before the invoice arrives.

HOW IT WORKS
  • Fee amounts are calculated in Salesforce and shared with each agency for approval
  • Once approved, a Vendor Bill case is raised in Salesforce
  • Workato listens for the platform event and creates the Vendor Bill in NetSuite automatically
Runs separately for ILS and all other currencies (USD).
